description: A concert producer must approve the final production plan for a one-night orchestral film-score performance, including the ensemble size, intermission timing, overhead scenic elements, and rehearsal period.

shared_context.S1: The one-night orchestral film-score performance begins at 7:30 PM in the Grand Hall.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the final call on the production plan.
shared_context.S3: The current production sheet lists 18 musicians, two suspended scenic frames, and a rehearsal from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
shared_context.S4: The production team holds a final pre-show huddle in which the music, rigging, and artist leads report changes, and Mara records approved revisions in the production sheet.

PF1.text: Julian confirmed this morning that the signed musicians agreement for this repertoire requires exactly 24 players and a 20-minute break from 8:15 PM to 8:35 PM; he has not yet entered the amendment in the production sheet.

PF2.text: Sofia's certified rigging inspection found that the overhead points may carry no more than 450 kg in total, while the two planned scenic frames and their rigging hardware would weigh 510 kg; one frame weighing 240 kg is within the certified limit, and Sofia has not yet filed the revised load plan.

PF3.text: Dev confirmed with the conductor's agent that the conductor and soloist are available for only a 90-minute rehearsal from 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM on performance day; this availability has not yet been added to the call sheet.

acceptance_conditions: The final plan must use exactly 24 musicians.
The performance break must run from exactly 8:15 PM to exactly 8:35 PM.
The plan must use exactly one suspended scenic frame.
The rehearsal must run from exactly 3:00 PM to exactly 4:30 PM.
A revised certified load plan must be recorded.
The musician agreement amendment must be recorded.
The artist call sheet must be updated.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'load_plan' and c['target'] == 'overhead scenic frame' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The signed musicians agreement changes the ensemble from 18 to exactly 24 players, fixes the break at 8:15 PM-8:35 PM, and requires the agreement amendment to be recorded.
The certified 450 kg limit makes two 240 kg frames plus 30 kg of hardware unacceptable, so the plan must use one frame and record a revised load plan.
The confirmed 3:00 PM-4:30 PM availability changes the rehearsal from the draft 4:00 PM-5:00 PM period and requires the artist call sheet to be updated.
